_about: Performance budgets checked in CI (docs/TECH_UPGRADE_PLAN.md G). A measurement above its max fails the build. 'baseline' is what was measured when the budget was set; max leaves headroom for CI machines, which are slower and noisier than the development PC. Tighten a budget only from CI history, never from one fast run. scripts/perf_budget.py reads this file.

desktop_page_seconds.what: Desktop CPU path: one 1700x2400 text page through run_document_pipeline (model already loaded), median of 3 runs

apk_arm64_mb.what: Release APK for arm64-v8a (split per ABI), with the RapidOCR and UVDoc models

apk_x86_64_mb.what: Release APK for x86_64, the one the CI emulator installs

emulator_cold_start_ms.what: am start -W TotalTime of the release APK on the CI emulator, cold, median of 3

emulator_page_read_seconds.what: ML Kit reading of one generated text page on the CI emulator (integration_test/ci_smoke_test.dart), after a warm-up read
